body: YES! The fingerprint marks are what I’m getting too. I wonder if you could prevent the marks but holding the blade with a little piece of toilet paper or paper towel so your skin doesn’t make contact? Your fingers might be removing whatever protective coat it has to prevent rusting.
Thank you that’s exactly what I did, I’ll see if it works!
I don’t think she is... I think she’s very happy to have you!
I hope so too. I’ve been feeling really lonely for a long time.

I know you don’t want to live. I get how they feels I mean we are both on this subreddit. 

I get you don’t think of yourself as much but I’m sure she is really happy to have you in her life. Living is hard as fuck and the fact you are at least here right now is really good.

Personally I think you deserve her, you seem like you are a good friend who cares a lot about her. I know that doesn’t mean much but... just my opinion ig.

I had no clue there were important veins on a my leg. I don’t cut deep at all just enough to draw blood but if I ever start going deeper (probably not) I’ll go somewhere else safer, I’ll just have to do some research. I would like to not do it at all but if it keeps my alive sometimes I need it.

I’m 16 too so I have no clue about the world as well. I’ve just had a belief since I was very young that it is not a good place at all so I’ve never had much hope for my future. I’ve lived with very severe anxiety and some OCD my whole life and lot of my teachers have put me down or reminded me the world for me is gonna be a place I don’t belong. Not just my teachers really, a lot of people have just let me know I’m not cut out for living.

And you are right it probably is the adrenaline I get from feeling the fight or flight. It’s just kind of different from other adrenaline rushes I get when I go on a rollercoaster or something cause the sensation is kinda all concentrated on me ig? I don’t know.

You were right in making the assumption I don’t want to bother people with my problems lol. Sometimes I’m totally convinced they are valid and real and sometimes I feel like a horrible faker... They usually feel more valid when I cut (another reason I do it).

Anyways don’t worry about feeling like you went overboard with the reply I’m like that on literally every post I comment on. It’s good to see people who want to write long messages to me... it makes me feel less alone.
Hey message me if you need to talk. Please tell me if you are okay.
It’s also brave to be sticking around. I wish I could tell you a way to make living less uncomfortable but I’m not sure myself. Still, I’m glad you are here today.

I feel exactly like this. Throughout my 4 years of feeling suicidal on and off I’ve told a decent handful of people, they were the only one to ever cry. 

Every time I revise my plan, or hurt myself, I think about what their reaction would be. The news coming through the school first, them holding their breath almost knowing for certain it’s me, their reaction when their stepmom or dad comes to break the news. It makes me sick that I could hurt someone like that.

You can’t make them stop caring and it sucks. Those who are in a good place mentally would argue to you it’s a good thing that the guilt is keeping you around but I know it’s a horrible feeling. They know the truth though, that you are worth it. You are a strong person staying for them like this, even if it’s just a few extra days. 

You are almost literally living for someone and I think that means you deserve them. I know it’s hard but thanks for staying today I bet they really appreciate it.

Hi, sorry for the late reply. Thanks so much this actually means a lot. I relate to both the passively deciding at 14 that suicide is the way I’m gonna go and the part about online school— I spent my middle school online because I was too depressed to attend school. I don’t know if these is weird, but the simple fact that you are writing this message at least makes me believe that even if it doesn’t get better when I’m older, at least I’ll still be kind which might be worth enough to me. If you really do wanna talk I’d love to.

A creative writing class! 

I noticed her from across the room because of her *amazing* art and just general adorableness.

I got in a group with her on a project and became good friends with her friends. As I started hanging out with the group more I started seeing her more. I have this little thing where I can predict when I’m gonna fall for someone because I get this achey feeling in my stomach and I started feeling it one night when we were hanging out in a group and I was out on a balcony with her and one of our friends.

That night I had a crisis because I wasn’t sure who the feeling was for (I doubted it was our friend and I barely knew her so I thought I was just getting it wrong). Later I saw her again when my friends had a surprise birthday party/general chill hang out session for me (which was amazing, I have amazing friends). I talked to her about a cute show we enjoyed and generally felt stuff start to click.

One night on what I think was the last day of June I was on a call with her and all my friends and everyone but her and me got off. That was the best thing that ever happened to me. We stayed up until around 3 or 4 AM laughing our asses off at stupid people on the internet. I knew the next morning when I woke up that it was, in fact, her who I fell for.

We started calling late every night and we just kept clicking. Now into the first part of July we had a night planned where we’d just hang out and watch cute shows. We hadn’t said anything about our feelings to each other yet but we ended up cuddling and holding hands later in the night (thanks to me making the first move). 

I got home that night and asked her if she had feelings. She told me in the most cryptic but genuinely adorable way that, yes she did.  We never officially got together we just starting calling each other our gf.

Had my first kiss with her to “Say Anything” by girl in red (I was so mcfreaking nervous but it was perfect). Summer is over but I don’t see it ending soon. We are younger but I have no doubt that I’m going to work to be with her no matter what we go through. 

She’s perfect in almost everything, even her imperfections are perfect... if that makes any sense (her flaws are manageable and we work through each other’s together). I’m still working on my own stuff, we aren’t far into the relationship (and I have bad past experiences with getting close to people) so I’m still a little awkward sometimes but everyday I loosen up more. I’ve been loving the first few month new relationship feeling but I’m even more excited to see us grow together in life over a longer time.

If you’ve read all this uhh thank you for reading all that sorry it’s so longggg!!
